title: Restriction of intrinsic pro-etale modules to constant scalars
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme in universe $u$ and $B$ a commutative ring in universe $u$. On the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], form the constant sheaf of rings $B_T$ by sheafification [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] [def-weil-pbc-sheafification], using $\operatorname{ULift}B$ in universe $u+1$. For a sheaf $M$ of $B_T$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], define its constant-scalar restriction to be the same underlying sheaf of abelian groups, with $\operatorname{ULift}B$ acting on $M(U)$ through the canonical sheafification-unit map $\operatorname{ULift}B\to B_T(U)$ on every site object $U$. Restriction maps and morphisms are the original maps, now linear for this constant scalar action; this is scalar restriction [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars] along the constant-presheaf unit. Thus obtain the specified functor $\operatorname{Mod}(B_T)\to\operatorname{Sh}(T_{proet},\operatorname{Mod}_{\operatorname{ULift}B})$, together with its defining scalar-unit map. No assertion of equivalence and no finiteness, nonzero-ring or nonempty-scheme hypothesis is part of this definition.
